headline: Viva.com officially takes over payment services with the Cypriot government
summary: Viva.com has officially taken over payment services for the Cypriot government. The new platform offers card payments and account-to-account transfers and aims to manage state transactions more efficiently.
why: Viva.com is a European payments provider, and government payment contracts are a source of recurring fee income in the public-sector payments market.
